verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline centred, bold and very legible, but it is blown up to fill the canvas. It is re-broken into three stacked lines with tight top and bottom margins, which loses the generous whitespace that carries the 'silence' message. B keeps the original two-line break and the airy feel, but the text block is small and sits clearly below centre. That leaves a large dead area at the top and a cramped bottom, so the composition looks lopsided and accidental rather than calmly centred like the original.
